text:
The Atlas planning summary (3–10 Nov) covers 25 modules. Later corrections override earlier drafts. Final values include upload queue_depth 500, inventory queue_depth 280, tenant queue_depth 50, webhooks retry_limit 6 and timeout_s 95, session ttl_s 480, alerts batch_size 850, profile batch_size 500, and archive timeout_s 85.

Hard rules prohibit dependency paths from checkout to feed, from archive to webhooks, and from session to webhooks. Inventory must not depend on sync, directly or indirectly. Gateway must run before audit and shipping. Several conditional limits link module settings. Worker assignments keep gateway/profile and media/tenant apart, and group audit/export together.

Other items: the budget and security reviews are upcoming, and the on-call rota changes next month. Sofia is on leave part of next week. The client is happy with progress, and the vendor contract has no blockers.
